subject: COLUMN clause
notes: (kb/Work PB1221, wave 1021 F). cite.py --check 13.18.14.3 "The keyword IS shall not be specified if COLUMNS, COLS, or NUMBERS is specified" -> OK SR5. The PLURAL half of reportColumnClause admits no IS, so COLUMNS IS 5, COLS IS 5, COLUMN NUMBERS IS 5 and COLS LEFT IS 5 are COBOL0001 (or COBOL0307 where error recovery reads the context-sensitive NUMBERS as a user word, 8.10); COLUMN IS, COL NUMBER IS and COL NUMBER CENTER IS compile and place their items. ReportClauseKeywordPrefixTests enumerates every combination. || Editions: COLUMNS/COLS/NUMBERS are 2002 spellings; the parse refusal holds at every edition.
